bar.text: ...SMALL CRAFT ADVISORY IN EFFECT UNTIL 4 AM PST TUESDAY... Combined seas 14 to 16 feet with breakers, subsiding to 10 to 13 feet late tonight. Bar conditions severe becoming rough. Maximum ebb currents will occur around 900 PM Monday, 1030 AM Tuesday, and 10 PM Tuesday.
